_meta.description: Reshape orders.pulse into a smaller hand-off cohort with materialize's output slot (pulse api materialize, never process): keep three columns, rename id to order_id, bucket revenue into labelled bands (open ends, so every order lands in one), drop ordered_at, and elide constants so the file stays small. Predict first (--predict) to read the output schema before writing; store the request as a template with the cohort as a variable to re-run it over each new cohort.
_meta.name: materialize_reshape_for_handoff

columns.description: Unique order identifier, renamed from id
Order revenue band in USD: small below 250, medium to 1000, large above
